name: rawpage
$comment-license: license is null because RawPage's own source is proprietary (Tech-Stack-Plan.md 8.1).
null means 'not an SPDX expression', which is the honest value here.
$comment-features: EVERY dependency from Tech-Stack-Plan.md 6.2 is declared here, but grouped into features
so that resolution can be TESTED now and REQUIRED later -- decision D0-3.
Why not put them all in the default set: risk A5 asks whether these ports build on the
x64-mingw-dynamic COMMUNITY triplet. Making OpenSSL a default dependency would couple
Stage 0's build to a Stage 10 dependency -- every configure paying for a library nothing
uses yet, and a Stage 10 port failure blocking Stage 1. Leaving them out entirely would
defer the A5 finding to whichever stage first needs them, which is the 'Stage 6 surprise'
Features resolve both problems: `vcpkg install --dry-run --x-feature=<f>` answers A5 today
for every group, while only `tests` is actually built. Each stage switches its feature on
as it arrives, and the answer is already known by then.
PDFium  -- no vcpkg port exists. Consumed as a prebuilt DLL through its C API (D0-6, A6).
Qt      -- from the official MinGW distribution, not vcpkg (Tech-Stack-Plan.md 6.3).
WiX v4  -- an authoring tool, not a linked dependency (Stage 15).
Xapian  -- GPL-2.0, REJECTED (Tech-Stack-Plan.md 6.2, risk R2). The port exists in vcpkg;
adding it would breach D4. A first-party inverted index replaces it.

dependencies.name: freetype
dependencies.$comment: Dual FTL / GPL-2.0. We elect FTL -- recorded explicitly in THIRD-PARTY.md.

dependencies.name: hunspell
dependencies.$comment: Tri-licensed 'MPL-1.1 OR LGPL-2.1-or-later OR GPL-2.0-or-later'. We ELECT the LGPL branch and, because that grant is '2.1 OR LATER', take it specifically as LGPL-3.0 -- the same licence as Qt, so one obligation model covers both: dynamic linking, user-replaceable binaries, a corresponding-source offer. The election and its reasoning are owned by tools/license-audit/spdx-map.json and reproduced in THIRD-PARTY.md; this comment must not drift from them again (I-21).

ocr.description: Optical character recognition (Stage 16 -- interface declared early, engine late)
